title: Pablo Exclusive Banana Ice Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Banana Ice Nicotine Pouches bring together the creamy taste of Banana with a cooling Ice finish for a sweet-meets-fresh sensation. With a strong 30mg per pouch nicotine content, these pouches deliver a bold yet smooth experience. Tobacco-free and discreet, each slim pouch is designed to sit comfortably under the lip, providing a steady release of nicotine without vapour or odour. It’s a great pick for users who enjoy dessert-style flavours with a cooling edge. A fun, flavourful pouch with a nostalgic feel, Banana Ice is ideal for experienced users who prefer stronger strengths and unconventional profiles. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
